rationale: US Treasury yields at 19-year peak continue as highest direct impact on US financial conditions; Pentagon munitions shortfalls and Hormuz tanker attack remain background concerns.

top_events.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
top_events.label: Pentagon confirms munitions shortfalls from Iran war
top_events.summary: Pentagon inspector confirms US munitions shortfalls and resupply bottleneck despite Trump's claims of limitless supplies. Direct concern for US military readiness and policy.

top_events.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
top_events.label: Tanker attacked in Hormuz Strait sailors missing
top_events.summary: Oil tanker struck by missile and drone in Hormuz; two sailors missing. Direct US concern through regional security and potential oil market impact.

top_events.title: Republican congressman calls to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
top_events.label: GOP congressman calls to impeach Defense Secretary
top_events.summary: Republican Thomas Massie calls for impeachment of Defense Secretary Hegseth, citing criticism of Iran war and military interventions. Domestic political rhetoric without enacted action.

most_significant_event.label: US bond yields hit 19-year high
most_significant_event.summary: 10-year Treasury yield reaches 5.02%, highest since 2007 financial crisis, as oil prices surge. Tightens financial conditions; affects mortgage rates, business borrowing, and household costs.
most_significant_event.title: Benchmark US government bond yield hits 19-year peak as oil prices surge
